title: Minimal getPathData / setPathData starter
blurb: Canonical 45-line starter normalizing an SVG path containing quadratic curves and arcs into plain M/L/C/Z objects, mutating cubic control points, and writing back with setPathData().
question: What is the minimum code required to normalize an arbitrary SVG path, edit its control points, and serialize it back via the browser?
result: getPathData({ normalize: true }) returns plain {type, values} objects in M/L/C/Z form and setPathData() writes back to the d attribute without a string parser (verified behind flag in Chrome 153; not verified in Chrome 160).
testedIn: Chrome 153 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI; not verified in Chrome 160
